arguments.code:
import {get_timeline,edit_timeline,validate_timeline,preview_timeline_frame,render_timeline} from "@nodetool-ai/sandbox-nodetool/timelines";
const id="83a5dfb0f663";await get_timeline({timeline_id:id});await edit_timeline({timeline_id:id,ops:[{op:"add_track",type:"subtitle",name:"Captions"}]});const state=await get_timeline({timeline_id:id});const track=state.timeline.tracks.find(t=>t.name==="Captions");const captions=state.timeline.clips.filter(c=>c.name.startsWith("Caption "));await edit_timeline({timeline_id:id,ops:[...captions.map(c=>({op:"move_clip",target:c.id,trackId:track.id})),{op:"move_track",target:track.id,toIndex:1}]});const validation=await validate_timeline({timeline_id:id});const preview=await preview_timeline_frame({timeline_id:id,times_ms:[1000,6500,12000],sheet:true,width:640});const finalState=await get_timeline({timeline_id:id});let render;try{render=await render_timeline({timeline_id:id,wait:true,timeout_ms:120000});}catch(e){render={error:String(e)}}return {finalState,validation,preview,render};
